raw.evidence: v_grid_static_effective has 1 row: static=8 bound to burst2, not steady24h or burst5. v_dim has 2-worker runs on steady24h (107) and 8-worker runs on burst5 (35), but also 8-worker on steady24h (34) and 2-worker on burst5 (101) — 'requirement' framing is not unique; both windows admit the other window's claimed value.
